fact: The Bank of Namibia's instant payments solution went live in June 2026 with Bank Windhoek, Nampost and Letshego Bank Namibia as first participants, ahead of a phased national rollout, per Deputy Governor Leonie Dunn.
Banks, authorised fintechs and e-money issuers are to serve the public through the interoperable Instant Payment Solution, which has finished piloting and is in phased rollout.
